system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Basic is a straightforward prompt instructing completions to be in JSON format, with no additional prompting techniques.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only evidence. Prompts are in App. A.3, which is not included in the evidence. The board state is passed as input.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Snap-Think begins with the SlowThinker con-structing a grouping setS and reasoningR based on the board state B, prior groupings HS, the SlowValidator’s latest feedback F , and failed attemptsHA.
env_context_strategy.note: The quote is copied from PDF text extraction, including its spacing and hyphenation artifacts. The board state is supplied directly in the prompt. There is no repo or navigation.

context_compaction.note: The paper states that history H is cleared after a successful attempt. This is task logic, not compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Players select and submit groups of four words for imme-diate feedback.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Basic is a straightforward prompt instructing completions to be in JSON format
tool_call_format.note: The quote describes the Basic baseline. The format Snap-Think itself uses is inferred.

tool_count.note: Agents submit guesses to the Connections engine. No tool list is described.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Players select and submit groups of four words for imme-diate feedback.
edit_primitive.note: This is a puzzle domain with no file editing.

protocol_standardization.note: The system is built on the Autogen framework.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If accepted, the grouping is submitted as an attempt. Ifk groupings are rejected ork′ incorrect attempts occur in suc-cession, Snap-Think transitions to the Snap cycle.
loop_primitives.note: The loop is propose, then validate, then submit with feedback, then retry. It switches between a slow cycle and a snap cycle.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Snap-Think maps Sys-tem 2 thinking to a structured critique loop

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The TVC framework consists of three spe-cialized agents: Thinker, Validator, and Consensus
multi_agent_topology.note: Snap-Think uses SlowThinker, SlowValidator, SnapThinker and SnapValidator.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: On a failed attempt, the category C is added to the previous guessesH, the retry counter increments

self_verification.evidence_quote: The SlowValidator critiques and evaluates (S,R ) usingB andHA.
self_verification.note: The judging role is a separate agent, and may use the same model.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This cycle repeats until all words are categorized or the retry limit is hit.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Systems were allowed a maximum of 20 incorrect guesses or could terminate early based on confidence
termination_condition.note: The run also ends when all words are categorized, which is the environment success condition.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: the Snap cycle works sufficiently well with smaller models like GPT-4o-mini, re-ducing computational costs
